cancelOrder.description: The `cancelOrder` function is a wrapper for the [`cancelOrder`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/orders/mutations/cancel-order/) mutation. You must pass an order ID and reason,
parameters: The ID of the order to cancel.
The reason for canceling the order.
The callback function to execute when the order is successfully canceled.
The callback function to execute when an error occurs.
cancelOrder.returns: Returns a promise that resolves to a void, null, or undefined value.

parameters: The ID of the order to cancel.
A key generated when a guest requests to cancel an order.
confirmCancelOrder.returns:
Returns a promise that resolves to an `OrderDataModel` object.

getAttributesList.description: The `getAttributesList` function is a wrapper for the [`attributesList`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/attributes/queries/attributes-list/) query. You must pass an attribute code to retrieve the list. The system default values are `CUSTOMER`, `CUSTOMER_ADDRESS`, `CATALOG_PRODUCT` and `RMA_ITEM`.
parameters: The entity type for which to retrieve the list of attributes.

getCustomer.description: The `getCustomer` function is a wrapper for the [`customer`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/customer/queries/customer/) query. You must pass a customer ID to retrieve the customer data.

getCustomerOrdersReturn.description: The `getCustomerOrdersReturn` function returns details about the returns a customer has requested. It is a wrapper for the [`customer`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/customer/queries/customer/) query.
parameters: The number of orders to return at a time.

getGuestOrder.description: The `getGuestOrder` function is a wrapper for the [`guestOrder`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/orders/queries/guest-order/) query.
parameters: The email address associated with the order.
The last name associated with the order.
getGuestOrder.returns:
Returns a promise that resolves to an `OrderDataModel` object or null.

<CodeInclude code={orderDataModel} lang="ts" frame="none" />

getOrderDetailsById.description: The `getOrderDetailsById` function is a wrapper for the [`customer`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/customer/queries/customer/) query. You must pass an order ID to retrieve the order details.
parameters: The ID of the order to retrieve.
The type of query to perform. Use orderData as the value
The number of returns to return at a time.
getOrderDetailsById.returns: Returns a promise that resolves to a `TransformedData` object.

getStoreConfig.description: The `getStoreConfig` function returns information about the storefront configuration. It is a wrapper for the [`storeConfig`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/store/queries/store-config/) query.

guestOrderByToken.description: The `guestOrderByToken` function retrieves a guest order using a token generated by Adobe Commerce. It is a wrapper for the `guestOrderByToken` query.
parameters: A token for the order assigned by Adobe Commerce.
guestOrderByToken.returns:
Returns a promise that resolves to an `OrderDataModel` object or null.

<CodeInclude code={orderDataModel} lang="ts" frame="none" />

reorderItems.description: The `reorderItems` function allows a logged-in customer to add all the products from a previous order into their cart. It is a wrapper for the [`reorderItems`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/orders/mutations/reorder-items/) mutation.

requestGuestOrderCancel.description:
The `requestGuestOrderCancel` function is simmilar to the `cancelOrder` function, but it is used for guest orders.
The token is a unique value generated using guest's email, order number and postcode
parameters: The token for the order assigned by Adobe Commerce.
The reason for canceling the order.
The callback function to execute when the order is successfully canceled.
The callback function to execute when an error occurs.
requestGuestOrderCancel.returns: Returns a promise that resolves to a boolean value.

requestReturn.description: The `requestReturn` function takes the `RequestReturnProps` form as an argument and initiates the process of returning items from an order. It is a wrapper for the [`requestReturn`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/orders/mutations/request-return/) mutation.
parameters: The form data for the return request.
requestReturn.returns: Returns a promise that resolves to an object containing the return request details.
